summary: Covers manufacturers of cigarettes, cigars, smokeless tobacco and next-generation nicotine products. Disclosures address public health, including harm-reduction products, and marketing practices such as legal losses and positions on WHO tobacco-control marketing rules.

questions.text: What are your (1) gross revenue and (2) revenue net of excise taxes from (a) non-tobacco nicotine products and (b) heated tobacco products?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report gross revenue and revenue net of excise taxes, each separately for (a) non-tobacco nicotine products and (b) heated tobacco products, in your presentation currency.

questions.text: What process does your organisation use to assess risks and opportunities associated with 'tobacco harm reduction' products?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe how risks and opportunities of harm-reduction products are assessed, including scientific evidence, regulation and public health considerations.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with marketing, labelling or advertising practices?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses (fines, settlements, damages) from legal proceedings related to marketing, labelling or advertising practices, in your presentation currency.

questions.text: What is your organisation's marketing policy, and what are your positions on Articles 11 and 13 of the World Health Organisation Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO FCTC)?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the marketing policy and your positions on Article 11 (packaging and labelling) and Article 13 (advertising, promotion and sponsorship) of the WHO FCTC.

questions.text: What was your combustible tobacco product sales volume for (1) cigarettes, (2) cigars and (3) other smoked tobacco products?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Metric tonnes (t) · Report sales volume for each of (1) cigarettes, (2) cigars and (3) other smoked tobacco products, in number of units or metric tonnes as appropriate.

questions.text: What was your non-combustible product sales volume for (1) traditional smokeless tobacco, (2) non-tobacco nicotine products, (3) heated tobacco products and (4) nicotine replacement therapy products?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report sales volume separately for each of (1) traditional smokeless tobacco, (2) non-tobacco nicotine products, (3) heated tobacco products and (4) nicotine replacement therapy products, in units.
